items.name: BBC
items.title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
items.text: Only a negotiated solution can end the conflict between the US and Iran, Tehran's foreign minister has said, after President Donald Trump publicly rejected a proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Trump told reporters at the White House that Iran's proposal was not acceptable and that Tehran wanted to make a deal to open the strait to commercial shipping within seven days because they're losing so badly. In a post on Telegram, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi acknowledged Trump's rejection, but said Iran would wait for a definitive official US response. He said the president had made contradictory statements in the past. Araghchi said the conditions to open the strait were the same that had been included in a memorandum of understanding between the US and Iran that was signed in June. Iran said it had raised reopening the strait and ending hostilities during negotiations on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. The vital waterway through which around a fifth of the world's gas and oil supply usually flows has been effectively closed since the outbreak of war in February. I'm rejecting their deal, Trump said.

facts.text: Trump told reporters at the White House that Iran's seven-day proposal was not acceptable.
Trump said: I'm rejecting their deal.
Trump said Tehran wanted a seven-day reopening because they're losing so badly.
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Iran would wait for a definitive official US response.
Araghchi said the conditions to open the strait were the same as the June US-Iran memorandum.
The strait usually carries around a fifth of the world's gas and oil.
The strait has been effectively closed since the war began in February.

items.name: qinbafrank
items.title: 中国冻结了伊朗在中国的资金么
items.text: 中国冻结了伊朗在中国的资金么？真实情况是什么？伊朗总统前两天接受福布斯的采访，他的原话是在中国的资金被 blocked（卡住了/受阻了），到社交媒体上就变成了 has been frozen（被冻结了）。这是两个完全不同程度和性质的表达。被卡住了只是资金使用不便；被冻结了则是资金完全不能使用。
items.note: Wording dispute about funds in China. Do not merge into the Hormuz reopen event. Persian original was not independently checked.
